editorial.tldr: On Oct 16, coverage framed Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 as a name without a released model, and one report said a new Chinese export-license requirement for large AI models could affect it. A week later, reports said it was being readied for release after Arena testing.
editorial.whats_new: On Oct 23, TestingCatalog reported Kimi K3.1 is being prepared for release after Arena testing, and R&D World published a comparison of Kimi K3.1 Pro against Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.
editorial.why_it_matters: A pre-release open-weight candidate with a possible export-licensing hurdle is a planning risk: availability, hosting terms and timing are unconfirmed.
editorial.take_for_builders: Do not wire Kimi K3.1 into production routing yet; queue an eval on your own tasks for when weights or an API appear, and check the license and hosting terms then.

status.detail: Kimi K3.1 appears to be nearing release after Arena testing, but the headlines here do not confirm a launch date or availability.
